reasons.claim: 3 eligible species within 250 m, all VU, forest-associated, felling-relevant, site-bound, 2024 records with 10 m uncertainty: Goodyera repens (132 m), Alectoria sarmentosa (133 m), Haploporus odorus (172 m).
Supporting: NT lichen Lobaria pulmonaria (120 m and further) and NT bird Picoides tridactylus (mobile) also recorded within 250 m.
Completed felling overlaps 4.7% of the 1.71 ha polygon, so not ALREADY_FELLED.
Effort is adequate (88th percentile). The 16 records within 250 m come from a single observation day and none are inside the polygon.

uncertainties: All near records come from one observation day, so this may reflect a single survey visit.
Records show species were recorded, not that they occupy the site now.
not_established: Presence or absence of species inside the polygon (no records inside, which is not absence).
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Human reviewer should check the 2024 records against the polygon and stand, and consider a field inventory before felling starts.
